dso_augment.csv.description: NightCrate editorial DSO augmentation: common-name overrides, non-galaxy surface brightness, curated distances.

sharpless_crossref.csv.description: Maps Sharpless 2 identifiers to existing DSOs from other catalogs (NGC/IC/Messier) to avoid duplicate entries for the same region.

barnard_crossref.csv.description: Barnard crossref placeholder (intentionally empty — see file comment).

dso_parts.csv.description: Reviewed "part of" list: catalog entries that cover several objects, such as the Cygnus Loop and its Veil pieces.

dso_match_overrides.csv.description: Reviewed match overrides that take precedence over matches a catalog or OpenNGC states.

melotte.csv.description: NightCrate's Melotte list: Melotte 1915 transcribed and checked against OpenNGC, SIMBAD and Hunt & Reffert 2023; positions for clusters without NGC or IC numbers.

arp_members.csv.description: Reviewed Arp member list: the galaxy at each member position of Webb's Arp index (VizieR VII/192), checked against SIMBAD, NED and OpenNGC.
